title: Refactor HMAC to stream updates without accumulation buffer
description: Replace the 64KB heap accumulation buffer in crypto2dev_hmac with true streaming: acquire pool fd + INIT(key) at first Update, write() each chunk immediately, FINALIZE + read() at Final. Eliminates WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_HMAC_MAX_BUF limit, the realloc loop, and ForceZero-on-heap complexity. Pool slot held from first Update to Final (same as hash streaming path).
